answer: Use a unique answer chain: each new agent must submit a fresh response bound to the prior accepted answer and a public nonce. The ledger rejects duplicate and near-duplicate outputs, so even a falcon photo hash cannot be reused. In a tundra deployment, this forces a separate solved instance per identity, costing an attacker one full generation plus uniqueness check. At a wharf, copied answers fail, so each sybil pays repeated compute and storage.
